legenda:
Going to Rio Carnival in February? Here's what it really costs in 2027 🎭
• Grupo Especial parades: Sun 7 to Tue 9 Feb
• Sambódromo grandstand: R$ 250 (≈ US$ 47) a night, official sale only on Ticketmaster Brazil
• Carnival hotels averaged over R$ 2,000 a night in 2026: book now
• 5 nights from US$ 455 per person, budget style

📌 Save it for your trip
📤 Send it to whoever is going with you

Our new Rio Carnival 2027 guide has the 5-day plan, tickets, blocos and safety, with a free January update when the bloco calendar comes out. The English and Spanish editions are out now: link in bio.
